answer: A practical defence is signed patent attorney registration with intellectual property office attestation. It rests on a registration the intellectual property office keeps on its public roll, which gives every honest agent a thread that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. A farm doing the maths finds the anchor first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The lantern is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
